steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to OpenProject at http://127.0.0.1:8090/ as admin with password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as shown), then open the project 'Bench Project' and its work packages list, and report the subjects of all work packages whose subject starts with 'Seed:'.

02-create: In the Bench Project work packages list, create a new work package of type Task titled '{{runid}} Bench Work Package'. In its details, set the description to include the text '{{runid}}', assign it to the user 'Bench Assignee' by selecting from the autocomplete dropdown (make sure an option is actually chosen, not just typed), set its status to 'In progress', and set the finish date to 2026-12-31. Save/close the work package and report its numeric ID shown as #<number>, plus the assignee, status, finish date as displayed.

03-open: Open the work package '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' ({{02-create.work_package_id}}) details page in Bench Project, add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}', then re-read and report the displayed values of: assignee, status, finish date, description, and confirm the comment appears on the page. Report each exactly as shown.
